context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 23 verified the redesigned homepage with cosmic features. New interactive components: 1) CosmicBg - animated particle background with shooting stars and parallax, 2) NatalWheel - SVG natal chart with rotating zodiac symbols and planets (hover for names), 3) CosmicScore - 4 animated progress bars (Amour/Carrière/Énergie/Intuition with static values), 4) TirageDuJour - daily tarot card component with reveal animation, 5) ShareableCard - profile card download for authenticated users. Key data-testids: homepage, hero-section, natal-wheel, cosmic-score, section-services, section-tirage-du-jour, shareable-card. Backend endpoints: GET /api/tarot/jour (daily tarot), POST /api/share/generate-card (profile card PNG). Registration gives 20 bonus credits. All navigation links working.
